$comment: Houdini Atlas — Curve Skeleton / Alien Limb starter pack node plan. Build by hand inside a Geometry SOP.

nodes.name: csv_import
nodes.rationale: Same control points for every learner so proof is reproducible.

nodes.name: make_polyline
nodes.rationale: Connect the 8 points into a single open polyline.

nodes.name: resample
nodes.rationale: 64 segments = 64 stable knuckles. Output @N + @curveu so downstream wrangles do not have to recompute.

nodes.name: wr_seg_id
nodes.rationale: Freeze a stable @seg_id BEFORE any deletion.

nodes.name: wr_orient
nodes.rationale: Robust quaternion orient that does not flip on degenerate up vector.

nodes.name: wr_width_scale
nodes.rationale: Map width to @pscale so Copy to Points scales each capsule non-uniformly.

nodes.name: seg_capsule
nodes.rationale: Cheap capsule — geometry first, instancing later.

nodes.name: copy_to_points
nodes.rationale: Drop one capsule per resampled point, transformed by @orient + @pscale.

nodes.name: OUT_alien_limb
nodes.rationale: Single output for downstream capstone consumption.

honesty: Capsule poly counts are intentionally low. The proof is orient stability + segment id stability, not surface quality.
